draft.subject: Subject: Update: Replacement Vehicle Dispatched for Nova Electronics Shipment
draft.body:
Subject: Update: Replacement Vehicle Dispatched for Nova Electronics Shipment

Dear Nova Electronics Team,

Following a mechanical breakdown, a replacement vehicle (Reg: RJ57LG5374) has been dispatched from our Jaipur hub to continue your shipment to Ahmedabad. We are currently estimating the delivery window based on route distance and will provide a confirmed ETA shortly. Please accept our apologies for this delay and thank you for your patience.

Best regards,
Meridian Freight Dispatch
